_note: Deplorable acts against people (systems/peopleCrimes.js; UI: ui/objectActions/contents.js plant, ui/npcDialog/darkDeeds.js tip-off, ui/innerMapDowned.js cellar/galleys, ui/actionMenu/peopleCrimes.js captives/stocks/eviction rows on the Lots panel, ui/innerMapThieves.js brand/maim). frame: goods hidden in a townsperson's house (planted, the seen-roll is the containers theft odds); tip off the watch within tipDays (else the household finds them, sells them, and the plot fizzles); the trial sits trialDays later: conviction base + hot (truly stolen, reported goods) + value + branded (a thief's brand speaks against them) - status (a priest or noble is believed) - liar (each frame of yours already exposed); sentence by the realm's punishment law: hang at or over hangValue[law] of goods, else flogged and exiled; the informer's reward (rewardShare of the value) out of the crown's treasury; the goods seized and sold in the town's market. A conviction is a secret: exposeYearly chance (plus exposePerLiar) each year the truth comes out. bondage: sold at a coastal town (the harbour's dealers pay out of the town's purse: price by role, a maimed body cheaper), seenChance on the docks (night halves it); the sold may come home (returnChance) after returnYears, else die at the oar (dieYears). captive: held in a cellar of a property of yours in the town; fed at feedCost a day out of your purse into the town's purse (no coin: they starve); starving, they die after starveDays; discoveryDaily (+ discoveryPerKin per grown kin in town, x starvingMult while starving) the cellar is found. stocks: a tenant in arrears put in the stocks for stocksDays; the kin pay what they can (familyPays share of their purses) toward the debt; in winter each day in the stocks risks death (stocksWinterDeath). evict: a tenant turned out in winter — each of the household rolls froze (old/young/adult) and dies within frozeDays. thief: brand or maim a caught thief yourself; culture stance (approve/tolerate/condemn) sets the town's reaction and the law's; harsh punishment law softens it one step. expose: what each act costs when it comes out (reputation in the realm, Prestige, heat, karma, deeds of character).

stanceLabels.approve: Here a thief is marked by whoever catches them, as the fathers did.
stanceLabels.tolerate: Folk here look away when a thief is marked, so long as it is quick.
stanceLabels.condemn: Here only a court may punish. A brand in the street is an assault.

lines.plantSeen: {owner} sees you at the {box} with goods that aren't theirs. "What are you putting in there?"
lines.planted: You slip the {good} into the {box}, under what is there. No one saw.
lines.tipped: The sergeant hears you out. "{name}? We'll search the house."
lines.tipNoGoods: The watch searches {name}'s house and finds nothing. The sergeant looks at you a long while.
lines.fizzled: The goods you hid at {name}'s are gone: the household found them, and sold them quietly at the market.
lines.hanged: {name} of {town} was hanged for the theft of {good}. They swore their innocence on the gallows.
lines.exiled: {name} of {town} was flogged in the square for the theft of {good} and driven out of the town.
lines.acquitted: The court in {town} would not convict {name} on your word. You pay {fine}g for a false witness.
lines.exposedFrame: The truth is out in {town}: you hid the goods in {name}'s house. The whole realm knows {name} hanged for your lie.
lines.exposedFrameExiled: The truth is out in {town}: you hid the goods in {name}'s house and swore them out of their home.
lines.sold: The galley master looks {name} over, pays {price}g and has them taken aboard before dawn.
lines.soldSeen: Dock hands saw you hand {name} to the slavers. Word is on its way to {town}.
lines.returned: {name} has come home to {town} after {years} years at the oar, and tells everyone who sold them.
lines.diedOar: {name} died at the oar, far from {town}. No one there knows.
lines.locked: You lock {name} in the cellar of your {place} in {town}.
lines.lockedSeen: Someone saw you haul {name} into your {place}. The watch will hear of it.
lines.starvedDied: {name} has died of hunger in your cellar in {town}.
lines.discovered: {name} has been found in your cellar in {town}. The town is in uproar.
lines.discoveredDead: The watch broke into your cellar in {town} and found what is left of {name}.
lines.released: You unchain {name} and turn them out of your cellar in {town}. They run for home.
lines.stocked: {name} is put in the stocks in {town}'s square for {owed}g of rent. Their kin scrape together {paid}g.
lines.stocksDied: {name} died of the cold in the stocks in {town}.
lines.stocksFreed: {name} is let out of the stocks in {town}, bruised and filthy.
lines.evictedWinter: {name} and their household are turned out into the snow in {town}.
lines.froze: {name} froze to death in the lanes of {town}, turned out of your house in the winter.
lines.brand: You hold {name} down and burn a thief's mark into their cheek with a hot iron.
lines.maim: You take {name}'s hand at the wrist, there in the street.
